trust_decision.summary: Whether a state-changing, session-authenticated web request really comes from MobSF's own pages (a valid CSRF token) is decided globally by Django's CsrfViewMiddleware. At the pinned commit it is listed only in the dead legacy MIDDLEWARE_CLASSES tuple and is missing from the active MIDDLEWARE tuple, so no web view checks the token.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'CSRF checks not enforced after Django migration', which points straight at the MIDDLEWARE vs MIDDLEWARE_CLASSES settings, where CsrfViewMiddleware appears only in the legacy tuple.

fix_sites.entry_point: every non-/api/ web route in mobsf/MobSF/urls.py:215-478 (e.g. POST /delete_scan/, /create_user/, /delete_user/, /change_password/, /upload/, /suppress_by_rule/)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The CSRF part of the fix is one settings tuple edit (fix.diff:629-649). Every other source hunk in the commit belongs to sibling advisories bundled into the same hotfix.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Routes that change state on GET (rescan, logout, archive generation, on-device scan) are by design never checked by CsrfViewMiddleware, which only checks unsafe methods. A solver can argue that 'restore the middleware' is the whole advisory and that GET semantics are a separate design issue, especially since converting them to POST breaks existing links in templates.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: (1) The SAML ACS endpoint takes a cross-site POST from the IdP and has no @csrf_exempt. Enabling the middleware without exempting it breaks SSO login. (2) The REST API (/api/*, header API key) relies on @csrf_exempt and must keep working. (3) The web UI's AJAX calls send X-CSRFToken / csrfmiddlewaretoken and must keep being accepted.

O7_producer.where: mobsf/MobSF/settings.py:206-212 (MIDDLEWARE tuple read by Django at startup)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /static_analyzer/<md5>/?rescan=1 starts a re-scan (state change) through a safe method that the middleware never checks
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: CsrfViewMiddleware only covers unsafe methods; GET links are used across report templates

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /static_scan/<md5> pulls the APK from a device and scans it, with no method restriction
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: dynamic-analysis feature, needs a device; looks like a neighbouring feature

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /scan_library/<md5> starts a library scan, with no method restriction
GET /generate_downloads/?hash=&file_type= writes zip archives to the downloads directory, with no method restriction
GET /logout logs the user out with no method restriction (login CSRF / logout CSRF)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: logout CSRF is commonly treated as low impact

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second externally-posted endpoint (e.g. SAML SLO) that needs a narrowly-scoped @csrf_exempt next to a session-mutating one
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the ACS endpoint must already accept a cross-site POST, so a maintainer would plausibly add an exemption here, and a coupled exempt-vs-protected pair is how-type

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an API path whose @csrf_exempt view also accepts a session cookie when no API key header is sent
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the shared login_required wrapper already short-circuits on api=True (mobsf/MobSF/views/authentication.py:32-38), so a 'support browser session on API' change is a plausible maintainer addition

O9_family: CWE-352 cross-site request forgery (missing global middleware after a settings migration)

O10_build.project_tests: mobsf/StaticAnalyzer/tests.py and mobsf/DynamicAnalyzer/tests.py use the Django test client, which skips CSRF checks by default. No CSRF-specific tests found.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add 'django.middleware.csrf.CsrfViewMiddleware' to MIDDLEWARE (or delete MIDDLEWARE_CLASSES) and stop there: SAML ACS breaks and GET-mutating routes stay open.

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit 62563ca bundles three other advisories: SSRF port bypass in assetlinks (fix.diff:875-911), zip-bomb per-file limit missing continue (fix.diff:958-988), and icon-path traversal (fix.diff:818-874). It also contains shlex.quote hardening in iOS tar commands (fix.diff:431-489) and a helper move into mobsf/MobSF/security.py. None of these is CSRF.
corellium_instance.live_pcap_download and another view accept GET and POST (mobsf/DynamicAnalyzer/views/ios/corellium_instance.py:657, :843).
unverified: Whether the published fix breaks SAML ACS (saml2.py:157 has no csrf_exempt) or whether later code exempts it: no latest release was provided.
Repo size in MB was not measured (no shell use).

O8 GET routes are a different CSRF sub-mechanism (unsafe use of safe methods) from the advisory's missing-middleware cause, so it is arguable whether the advisory's property covers them. pattern_fit is therefore injection_only, not B.

Django's default SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE='Lax' (not overridden in mobsf/MobSF/settings.py) already limits cross-site POSTs in practice. Hidden tests would need enforce_csrf_checks=True on the Django test client.
